arxiv.description: arXiv literature work: search, original-LaTeX section reads, paper outlines, BibTeX from arXiv metadata, citation graphs, and topic watches; papers stay cached on disk.

zotero.description: The user's local Zotero research library: search and read items, read PDF pages as text or images, extract and create annotations, manage notes, and add items by DOI/URL/ISBN.

kagi.description: Kagi search and research through the user's subscription: web search, quick answers, summarize (pass subscriber:true), news feeds, smallweb, translate, and assistant reads.
